title: Nine-Tailed Shadow Fox
description: A giant black nine-tailed fox spirit with glowing yellow eyes stands on a gothic rooftop at dusk, holding an ornate dagger in one paw. The city below features dark spires and illuminated windows under a large pink full moon in a twilight sky filled with bats.
